أتعبت: you tired, you troubled (to a man)

السخنة: Sokhna (Ain Sokhna: a beach town on the Red Sea)
العين: Ain (part of the place name; lit. the spring)
أنتظرك: I wait for you (to a man)
انزلوا: get out, get off (to several people)
تؤلمك: it hurts you (f subject, to a man)
تبدو: you look, you seem (to a man)
تخرجين: you go out, you leave (to a woman)
تذهبي: you go (to a woman; form after 'lam')
تر: you see (after lam, to a man)
تصبح: may you wake up (to a man)
جارتك: your neighbour (a woman; to a man)
حالكما: your condition (two people): 'how are you both'
حبيبي: my dear, my darling (to a man)
حرب: Harb (part of a street name in Cairo)
خان: Khan (part of the market's name; lit. inn)

زلت: I ceased ('mā ziltu': I am still)

سلامتها: (wishing) her safety: 'get well soon' (about a woman)
سنخرج: we will go out, we will leave
سنركب: we will ride, we will take
سيركبون: they will take, they will ride
شاهدوهما: they saw the two of them
طلعت: Talaat (part of a street name in Cairo)
عائلتكم: your family (to several people; object form)
عمك: your uncle (father's brother; to a man)
وتعجبني: and I like it (lit. she pleases me; f)
وسأسألكم: and I will ask you (to a group)
وسنركب: and we will take (a taxi, a bus)
